text: ポケモン　１ひきでは　わたしたち　とは　たたかえないわ

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb's last sound to an え-sound plus る means 'can do', and with ない it becomes 'can't'. たたかえない = 'can't battle'.

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: で tells what you use, and は added to it gives the feeling 'with just that, no'. １ひきでは = 'with only one (it won't work)'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person shows who you do something with or against; は picks 'us' out. わたしたち　とは = 'with us'.
